name: Banana Pancakes
assumptions: Yield estimated from instructions that produce two batches of two pancakes each (4 total), typical for 2 small servings.
Preparation time conservatively estimated from explicit cook times (1-2 min per side × 4 pancakes) plus mashing/mixing/setup.
Gluten-free assumes no wheat in baking powder or vanilla; no grains or gluten-containing items listed.
Dairy-free assumes neutral oil with no butter or milk products.
Tree nuts marked true due to explicit pecans; peanuts left null as no peanuts or shared facility info given.
Oil left ambiguous (could contain soy if soybean oil).
Vanilla extract left ambiguous for potential additives.
instructions:
In a bowl, mash the banana with a fork until it resembles a thick purée. Stir in the eggs, baking powder and vanilla.
Heat a large non-stick frying pan or pancake pan over a medium heat and brush with half the oil. Using half the batter, spoon two pancakes into the pan, cook for 1-2 mins each side, then tip onto a plate. Repeat the process with the remaining oil and batter. Top the pancakes with the pecans and raspberries.

ingredients.name: Banana
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large banana (118 g flesh + peel adjustment, peeled edible portion ~136 g total used in mash)

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium eggs (USDA large ~50 g each edible without shell)

ingredients.name: Baking Powder
ingredients.assumptions: pinch of baking powder estimated at 1 g (typical small pinch for recipe)

ingredients.name: Vanilla Extract
ingredients.assumptions: sprinkling of vanilla extract estimated at 2 g (~1/2 tsp, common amount in pancake recipes)

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp oil (vegetable or neutral oil, ~5 g; used for brushing pan)

ingredients.name: Raspberries
ingredients.assumptions: 125 g raspberries as listed (fresh, edible weight)
